description: Privileged access to the Places database (places.sqlite).

types.description: A table in one of the schemas attached to the Places connection.

schema.description: The attached schema name, e.g. 'main' or 'favicons'.

functions.name: getTables
functions.description: List the tables and views across every schema attached to the Places connection.

functions.name: getRows
functions.description: Return rows from a table, along with its column names.

schema.description: The attached schema the table belongs to.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. 0 means no limit.

orderBy.description: Column to sort by. Must be a real column of the table.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against every text column.
